description.narrative: The most significant expected project-level outcome is an increase in coordinated access to high quality healthcare services in Ecuador. The Project supports the establishment and operation of a new specialty care hospital in Cumbaya that will contribute to alleviating the burden of disease for patients through reduction in travel time and access to new specialties care and will create direct and indirect job opportunities, including for medical professionals. Beyond the project, IFC anticipates that this investment will promote competitiveness in the healthcare market, particularly in Cumbaya.

The proposed investment consists of an IFC A Loan of up to US$25 million to Conjunto Clinico Nacional Conclina (Conclina or the Group), a leading integrated healthcare group based in Ecuador. The Group includes (i) Hospital Metropolitano, the leading high-complexity private hospital with 141 beds in the country which enjoys one of the strongest reputations for quality of care (first and only one accredited by Joint Commission International, JCI - a global healthcare certification), located in Quito; (ii) Humana, the third largest prepaid medicine insurance entity in the country; and (iii) Metrored, an ambulatory care network with 7 outpatient clinics in Quito, Cumbaya and Guayaquil. The proposed IFC loan will finance: (i) the construction of a new up to 70-bed-hospital under the Metropolitano brand in the Cumbaya area of Quito; (ii) two medical towers for doctors offices; and (iii) upgrades to the existing infrastructure of Hospital Metropolitano including digital transformation investments (The Project).
